trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WITH p, regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS birth_year, CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64) WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12 ELSE NULL END AS birth_month, CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})$', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, ' ([0-9]{1,2}),', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day WHERE p.nationality = 'British' OR p.birth_date = '1972/3/6' OR CAST(birth_year AS INT64) < 1984 OR (CAST(birth_year AS INT64) = 1984 AND (birth_month < 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day <= 14))) RETURN p.nationality AS col1, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS col2
